design:
D1 Hazard and rollback (Tier 2). A model compares untrusted claims; its answer becomes files in the working tree, and a new operator route writes a source. No migration: dated is a metadata field, contradictions are files, and the check is a step of an existing job. Rollback is a revert. Contradiction files left behind are plain JSON under knowledge/contradictions, which the previous Hub never reads; a decision source reads as an unknown type there, which the map already lists. The bundle reaches :8000's app on its next reload; before its Hub restarts, the contradictions route answers 404 and the section reads as empty.

D2 Inside distillation (operator, 2026-10-09). The same runner and model, one more spawn after a distillation that stored facts, recorded with trigger facts_written. Rejected: a separate job, which would be a second switch whose off state silently hides contradictions.

D3 All facts, capped (operator, 2026-10-09). Claims of other sources' facts, latest-dated first, to 50,000 characters, the leftovers counted in the detail. Rejected: a shared-word prefilter, which misses the same rule phrased differently.

D4 Newer by when it was said (operator, 2026-10-09). An optional dated on the source; a fact's date is its source's dated, else its source's created_at date; created_at breaks a tie. Rejected: upload order, wrong for a backlog.

D5 Derived, never rewritten. disputed, presumed and superseded_by are computed from contradiction files on each read, as the map is from the files. A fact record is never edited after it is written.

D6 Pick one plus a note (operator, 2026-10-09). The resolution writes a decision source (new type decision) whose text states both facts, the choice and the note, and the contradiction records stands and the decision's id. Rejected: free text alone, which leaves the choice to a model reading it. Decision sources are not distilled: their content restates facts already in the vault.

D7 The model names ids, the Hub checks them. The answer is a list of {new, existing, explanation}; a pair whose ids are not one new and one sent fact, or that is already recorded either way round, is dropped. Within-source contradictions are out of scope.

D8 Privacy follows the facts (roadmap D3): private when either fact is, with a claimless stub naming the two fact ids.

lifecycle: When closed, this change folds into the knowledge-vault capability, and the roadmap's contradictions slice is then done.
problem: Distillation (knowledge-vault FR-10..FR-17) writes facts from each source independently. When two meetings disagree, say on a refund limit, both facts sit in the vault as equals, and an agent that reads one is not told the other exists. The operator's rule (2026-10-09): 'A meeting transcipt is authoritative evend if two meetings contradict we should point that out', and 'Yes show both presume the newer one.' Roadmap D4 makes contradictions first-class records, the newer presumed and both marked disputed until the operator resolves it with a recorded decision.

requirements.rationale: Operator, 2026-10-09: newer means when it was said. A backlog of old transcripts uploaded today must not override a newer decision.
requirements.statement: POST /vault/sources MUST accept an optional dated (YYYY-MM-DD), store it in the source's metadata and stub, and list it in the map; it MUST answer 400 for any other format. A source's date is dated when present, else the date of its created_at.

requirements.rationale: Operator, 2026-10-09: inside distillation, so nothing extra to enable. Manager D4: every spawn is one firing.
requirements.statement: When a distillation stores at least one fact, the vault-distillation job MUST make one more spawn comparing the newly stored facts with the existing facts of other sources, and record it as one manager_job_fired event with trigger facts_written, subject {"source": <id>}, and outcome written when it recorded at least one contradiction, empty when none, failed when the spawn failed or its answer did not parse.

requirements.rationale: Operator, 2026-10-09: all facts, capped. About 25 tokens a claim; the cap is about 2,000 facts.
requirements.statement: The check MUST send every existing fact of other sources whose claim is on this machine, as its id and claim, latest-dated first, up to 50,000 characters of claims. Facts beyond the cap MUST be left out, and the firing's detail MUST say how many were.

requirements.rationale: Roadmap D2 and D4: one file per contradiction, citing both facts; the newer is presumed. The model names ids; the Hub checks them, so a contradiction can only cite facts that exist.
requirements.statement: Each contradiction the model names MUST be stored as contradictions/<id>.json (id ctr- followed by 12 hex characters) holding id, kind, facts (the two fact ids), presumed, explanation, status open, visibility, created_at and found_by (job and model), but only when one fact is among the new ones, the other among those sent, and no contradiction between the same two facts exists already. presumed MUST be the fact whose source's date is later, the later created_at breaking a tie.

requirements.rationale: Roadmap D3: a contradiction reveals both claims, so it is private whenever either fact is.
requirements.statement: A contradiction involving a private fact MUST be private: its record written at the effective private location, and only a stub (id, kind, visibility, holder, created_at, facts) written as knowledge/contradictions/<id>.json, holding no claim and no explanation.

requirements.rationale: Roadmap D4: an agent reading a disputed fact is told it is disputed rather than handed a guess. Derived on read, so fact files are never rewritten.
requirements.statement: A fact in an open contradiction MUST be listed in the map with disputed true and presumed true or false, and a fact that lost a resolved one with superseded_by naming the decision source. vault_read of such a fact MUST say, in its content, that it is disputed, the other fact's id and claim, and which one is presumed, or that it was superseded and by which decision. GET /vault/contradictions MUST list every contradiction, open first.

requirements.rationale: Operator, 2026-10-09: pick one plus a note. Roadmap D4: the resolution is a decision record with a source.
requirements.statement: POST /vault/contradictions/{id}/resolve with stands (one of its two fact ids, or null for neither) and note MUST write a source of type decision, whose text names both facts, which stands and the note, with the contradiction's visibility; MUST mark the contradiction resolved with stands, note, the decision's id and the time; and MUST answer the contradiction. It MUST answer 404 for an unknown id, 400 when stands is neither fact nor null or the note is empty, and 409 when it is already resolved. A decision source MUST NOT be distilled.

requirements.rationale: Distillation replaces a source's facts on success; an open contradiction on a fact that no longer exists would point at nothing.
requirements.statement: When a distillation deletes a source's earlier facts, every open contradiction citing one of them MUST be deleted; a resolved one MUST be kept.

requirements.rationale: The operator resolves contradictions where they read the vault.
requirements.statement: The Vault tab MUST show a Contradictions section listing the open ones, each with both claims, their sources' dates and which is presumed, and a form to choose the fact that stands or neither, write a note and resolve; a refusal shows the Hub's reason. A disputed fact MUST carry a disputed mark and a superseded one a superseded mark wherever facts are listed. The upload form MUST offer the date.

in_scope: An optional dated field on sources, set at upload, deciding which side of a contradiction is newer
A contradiction check inside the vault-distillation job, after it stores facts, recorded as its own firing
Contradiction records: one file each, private when either fact is
Disputed, presumed and superseded, derived on read and shown in the map, the fact card and the Vault tab
Resolving: the operator picks the fact that stands or neither, with a note, stored as a decision source
A Contradictions section in the Vault tab, and a date field in the upload form
non_goals: Contradictions within one source: a source is checked against the others, not itself
Agent reports about wrong facts (agent-reports slice)
Warnings on requirements that contradict a fact (specs-against-the-vault slice)
Re-checking the whole vault on demand: only new facts are compared
Editing a source's date after upload

summary: After the manager distils a source, it makes one more call comparing the new facts with the facts already in the vault, and records each contradiction it finds as a file citing both facts. The fact from the later-dated source is presumed; both are marked disputed in the Vault tab, in the map and in vault_read, so an agent is told the newer claim and that it is disputed rather than handed a guess. Sources gain an optional date (when the meeting happened), so a backlog uploaded out of order still presumes the right fact. The operator resolves a contradiction by picking the fact that stands, or neither, with a note; the Hub stores that as a decision source, and the losing fact reads as superseded. Tier 2: a model on untrusted text, new records written into the working tree, and an operator route that writes.
